newsitem.title: UK: GDR REPORT - India slumbers in light London trade.
newsitem.headline: GDR REPORT - India slumbers in light London trade.

text.p: Settlement on the Bombay Stock Exchange (BSE) cut away any enthusiasm to trade global depositary receipts (GDRs) in London.
"It was simply dead after a bumpy week," said a trader.
The HSBC James Capel Indian GDR index closed up just 0.13 points at 56.59 with the premium over the local market at 15.79 percent compared with Thursday's 16.24 percent.
The Bombay Stock Exchange 30-share index ended 0.89 points higher at 2,881.15.
"There were very few orders in this market today," said the trader.
The Capel Korea GDR Index ended down 0.29 points at 60.74, a premium of 36.67 percent over the local market after the Korea Composite Index fell 2.68 points to 686.70.
The Capel Taiwan GDR Index ended off 0.41 points at 93.50, a premium of 3.58 percent after the Taiwan Weighted Index dropped 0.52 points to 6,825.10. -- David Chance London newsroom 44 171 542 5887
